answer: A falcon-eyed auditor patrols every epoch. Each identity must stake a jade marker that grows in value with every honest submission and shrinks with every flagged one. The auditor randomly reviews a oasis of submitted answers, checking provenance and originality; a fake identity loses its marker, so the attacker pays per identity. Because the marker is non-transferable and earned, not bought, a fleet of sybils must each hold a separate marker that survives review - the cost is linear in fleet size and repeats every epoch, so one payment cannot cover the swarm.
